aircraftCfg._comment: Use aircraft.cfg as high-confidence fallback only when the B789 type designator is paired with Horizon variation evidence.

lvars._comment: The cited Horizon sources do not define a 787-9 custom integration table. This profile inherits the Asobo 787 family profile and keeps SimConnect as the active telemetry path.

controls._comment: No active Horizon 787-9 custom controls are mapped because the cited Horizon sources do not define an external-control interface.

meta.notes: Horizon Simulations Boeing 787-9 profile for the Orbx-distributed freeware add-on. Product identity is based on the official distribution listing. No vendor-documented custom interface is active, so telemetry and controls remain on standard SimConnect and inherited 787-family behavior.

sources.title: Horizon Simulations Boeing 787-9 - Microsoft Flight Simulator
sources.notes: Orbx product page identifies the add-on as the Horizon Simulations Boeing 787-9 freeware package for Microsoft Flight Simulator. It supports product identity only and does not define custom telemetry or controls.

sources.title: Installer - Headwind Simulations
sources.notes: Headwind's installer page describes installation for Headwind Simulations add-ons. The page did not publish a Boeing 787 custom-variable map, so no Headwind-specific 787 variables were activated.

verification.notes: Product identity is documented by the Orbx product page. Active mappings are limited to inherited SimConnect behavior pending a vendor-documented interface and in-sim verification.
